query:
UPDATE feed_sources
             SET feed_title = COALESCE(feed_title, ?),
                 language = COALESCE(language, ?),
                 source_type = CASE WHEN ? AND source_type = 'rss' THEN 'podcast' ELSE source_type END,
                 last_polled_at = ?,
                 last_polled_by = ?,
                 last_error = NULL,
                 last_error_by = NULL
             WHERE collection_id = ?
